stem.text: Which statement about immunity is correct?

A.text: Antibody donation, but not antibody production, occurs with artificial active and artificial passive immunity.

B.text: Artificial active immunity lasts for a greater length of time than natural passive immunity.

C.text: Natural active immunity provides a faster response to infection than artificial active immunity.

D.text: Recognition and binding by specific B-lymphocytes only occurs with natural immunity.
